description: AIRWISE: Environmental Sensor and LLM Query Dataset for Edge AI-Based Air-Quality and Thermal-Comfort Analytics is published by VAROL, Aygün; Kołodziej, Katarzyna; Sobczak, Łukasz; Romaszewski, Michał; Głomb, Przemysław; Hossein Motlagh, Naser. It describes indoor and outdoor environmental sensor series and labelled question-answer pairs for the AIRWISE edge-AI benchmark. Coverage is regional within FI, PL.
